faqs.question: How fast is my Minecraft server deployed after payment?
faqs.answer: Instant deployment. Your server is automatically provisioned and ready in under 60 seconds the moment your payment is confirmed. You receive an email and dashboard notification with your IP address, SFTP credentials, and Noble Panel login.

faqs.question: What payment methods do you accept in Pakistan?
faqs.answer: We support all major Pakistani payment channels: EasyPaisa (Instant wallet & QR), JazzCash (Direct transfer & Till ID), SadaPay, NayaPay, Raast / Pakistani Bank Transfers (1Link), as well as international Visa, Mastercard, and Crypto (USDT, BTC, LTC).

faqs.question: Where are your servers located and what ping can I expect?
faqs.answer: Our flagship nodes are stationed in Karachi and Lahore, Pakistan, directly peered with Tier-1 national backbones including Nayatel, PTCL, StormFiber, Transworld, Jazz, and Zong. Players in Pakistan experience ping as low as 5ms to 18ms. We also operate global POPs in Dubai (30ms), Singapore (55ms), and Frankfurt (110ms).

faqs.question: What DDoS protection is included with my server?
faqs.answer: Every Noble Node server includes enterprise-grade 12+ Tbps Corero and Path.net DDoS protection at zero additional cost. Our always-on inline scrubbing filters Layer 3, Layer 4, and Layer 7 Minecraft-specific game attacks (Botnets, Null Ping, Handshake Floods, UDP Amplification) with sub-millisecond reaction time and zero server disconnects.

faqs.question: Can Minecraft Bedrock (Mobile, Xbox, PS5, Switch) players join my Java server?
faqs.answer: Yes! We offer pre-configured GeyserMC and Floodgate cross-play on all Paper and Purpur tiers. Bedrock edition players on Android, iOS, Windows 10/11, PlayStation, Xbox, and Nintendo Switch can join your Java world seamlessly on the same IP and port.

faqs.question: Can I change my server version or install custom modpacks?
faqs.answer: Absolutely. Noble Panel includes a 1-click modpack and version installer with full support for Paper, Purpur, Fabric, Forge, NeoForge, Spigot, BungeeCord, and Velocity. You can install thousands of modpacks directly from CurseForge and Modrinth with a single click, or upload custom .jar and zip files via SFTP or Web File Manager.

faqs.question: How do automated daily backups work?
faqs.answer: Your entire server (worlds, configs, player data, and plugins) is automatically backed up every 24 hours to offsite secure cloud storage. You can also take manual snapshot backups anytime from Noble Panel and restore with one click if anything goes wrong.

faqs.question: Can I upgrade or downgrade my plan later without losing data?
faqs.answer: Yes, you can upgrade your RAM, CPU vCores, or NVMe storage anytime from your Account Dashboard. Upgrades take effect instantly upon renewal with zero file loss, IP change, or world resetting.

faqs.question: Do I get a free custom server address/subdomain?
faqs.answer: Yes! Every server comes with a free custom subdomain such as yourserver.noblenode.host. If you own your own domain (e.g. play.yourserver.pk), you can link it directly using our simple DNS guide.

faqs.question: What kind of customer support is available?
faqs.answer: We provide 24/7 technical support in both English and Urdu through our official Discord community and priority ticketing system. Our team of experienced server administrators is always on standby to assist with plugin errors, crashes, and performance optimization.
